answerCheck.reason: Let AC = c, BD = d, and let θ be their acute angle. The projections give c cos θ = 6 and d cos θ = 8, hence c = 3d/4. The area gives cd sin θ = 30. Eliminating θ and setting t = d² yields t² - 64t - 1600 = 0. Its positive root is 32 + 8√41, so m + n + p = 32 + 8 + 41 = 81.
